basics.name: Rogério Araújo
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience building and shipping production software across web, mobile, and backend systems. Product-minded engineer who takes features from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and production reliability. Experienced with TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, Rust, Golang, relational databases, search, and distributed systems in fast-moving SaaS and startup environments. Uses AI coding tools such as Claude and Cursor to accelerate codebase exploration, planning, implementation, and review, with engineering judgment and testing to validate results.

roles.summary: Owned architectural design and foundational development for an internal Backoffice platform supporting sportsbook operations, defining reusable patterns and core capabilities for future evolution.
highlights: Defined the platform foundation and architectural approach for an internal Backoffice, working across authentication, authorization, and access-control requirements.
Designed reusable integration patterns and service boundaries to support maintainability, secure access, and future operational workflows.
Draftea acquired Pitaco in March/2026.
Technologies: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Node.js,  Vercel, WorkOS.

roles.summary: Owned end-to-end feature delivery across mobile (Flutter), web (React/Next.js), and backend (Rust) for a Brazilian sportsbook serving 2M+ customers.
highlights: Led features from technical discovery and design through implementation across web, mobile, and backend, including KYC, authentication, access control, and real-time sportsbook experiences.
Wrote and reviewed technical RFCs, shaping cross-platform architecture and balancing product needs, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed.
Worked with PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, and TimescaleDB across product and real-time use cases, alongside observability and performance monitoring.
Improved product decision-making through Datadog, Statsig, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, and Meta Conversions API integrations for monitoring, experimentation, and attribution.
Mentored junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing; contributed to web performance and internal operational tools.

roles.summary: Delivered cross-platform product features in a fast-moving startup, collaborating with UX on design and implementation.
highlights: Partnered with UX to deliver onboarding and activation improvements across web and mobile; the original resume records an approximately 15% increase in new-user activation.

roles.summary: Built acquisition and technical SEO capabilities for Rei do Pitaco during an early stage of the startup, supporting thousands of daily users.
highlights: Built an Angular Universal-based internal tool for the Universo Pitaco content platform and implemented technical SEO improvements.
Maintained acquisition services and improved website performance to support organic discovery and user acquisition.

roles.summary: Contributed to SaaS applications and cloud integrations in a global engineering team, working on SAP BTP.
highlights: Created and maintained the SAP DRC (Document Compliance) SaaS application and integrations with external services.
Facilitated sprint planning and team ceremonies as a temporary Scrum Master.
Implemented unit and end-to-end tests and maintained technical documentation.
Technologies: Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Jest, Karma, Docker, Kubernetes, Kyma, SAP HANA, BTP, Jenkins, Fiori/UI5.

roles.summary: Built backend services and APIs for document- and image-intelligence automation products.
highlights: Developed and maintained microservices and REST APIs, integrating RabbitMQ-based messaging into service workflows.
Worked across relational and NoSQL databases and containerized deployments, with unit tests, end-to-end tests, and technical documentation.
Technologies: Python, Go, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, DynamoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, Vue.js, Flask, Django, Nginx.

roles.summary: Built full-stack B2B e-commerce and payment products, including checkout flows, internal dashboards, and payment-gateway integrations.
highlights: Built and maintained transactional checkout experiences for Shopify-integrated businesses.
Integrated payment providers including Mercado Pago, PagSeguro, PicPay, Juno, and Pix.
Technologies: Vue.js, Node.js, AdonisJS, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS, Heroku, Serverless.
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Maven, PostgreSQL.
